scope: Preserve supported flags for predeclared mandatory DXF BYBLOCK, BYLAYER and CONTINUOUS LTYPE rows, and refuse late nondefault flags that would be lost.
finding: Before the fix, an unseeded canonical CONTINUOUS callback with flags 16 succeeded but fresh DXF readback reported flags 0.
change: Use validated flags from predeclared canonical metadata when writing mandatory rows. A nonzero callback flag must match a predeclared row; a zero callback flag retains predeclared flags. Invalid predeclared flags and late or mismatched nonzero flags refuse without publishing partial output.
checks: Generated AC1009, AC1014 and AC1032 ASCII and Binary tests cover all three mandatory names and flag values 16, 48, 64, 80 and 112 with fresh readback.
Unseeded and mismatched nonzero flags, plus invalid flag 32, refuse atomically; the same writer retries with the expected row and byte-identical output.
Default callback rows retain predeclared source flags; default unseeded rows and source-handle aliases remain functional.
Focused CTest: libdxfrw_ltype_table_allocation, libdxfrw_appid_table_allocation and libdxfrw_dxf_source_table_identities passed 3/3.

A previously built LibreCAD system-codec test binary was relinked against the newly installed library: the targeted LTYPE test passed 17 cases and 4135 assertions; one ODA-fixture case was skipped. The changed libdxfrw.cpp.o SHA-256 matched in build and installed archives: cd322f8e102f2d317fe687423f4ec6828af40fb48b95ad0521f4b3e8f32d5126.
limitations: The LibreCAD check reused previously compiled consumer objects and was not a clean consumer rebuild; the optional ODA fixture case was not run.
This slice preserves flag values only. Canonical descriptions and nonempty patterns may still be replaced by built-in values and need separate disposition.
Generated codec readback does not establish independent producer semantics or whole-document support.
